observations: Only the QA Cursor pool used coder_agent_connection with a 2m grace measured from build creation, a 3m dispatch deadline and 0s reap delay. The tester reported starting Cursor at 11:54 AM CST (17:54 UTC, minute precision); the Relay claimed one request at 17:54:21 UTC and Coder recorded build creation at 17:54:21.623833 UTC.

The build succeeded at 17:54:32 UTC, but the agent never connected. The reaper kept the workspace before the 2m threshold and failed the runner at 17:56:45.980 UTC, build age 2m24s, on its next sweep after the grace expired.

Cursor accepted a retryable worker-stage fail-claim at 17:56:46.467 UTC; applied=true was confirmed by the metric. The tester supplied a screenshot showing the self-hosted pool error and the exact safe retry guidance sent by the Relay. Screenshot creation metadata records 18:13:10 UTC, not when the error first appeared; the prompt marker was not independently observed.
The QA workspace was gone by 17:57:03 UTC. The original QA config and binary were restored byte-for-byte and both QA pools were healthy by 18:01:44 UTC; no manual workspace deletion was needed.
